summary: TRX Gold Corporation furnished a Form 6-K with two press releases dated September 14, 2026, reporting preliminary fiscal Q4 and full-year 2026 operating results and index inclusion. Record quarterly gold production of 8,173 ounces rose 28% year over year, while annual production of 29,650 ounces increased 57% and hit the top of 25,000-30,000 ounce guidance. Realized gold prices averaged roughly $4,233/oz in Q4 and $4,386/oz for the year. The filing also notes process plant upgrades and SAG/Ball mill expansion progress. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed.
